title: DLC helpers
purpose: Shared movement, guarded drone scheduling and mining helpers.
start: Import this module without running a farm. Sensor-based helpers need Underground Senses; the first blocks program can use the unsensed branch.

title: Blocks
purpose: Collect ordinary blocks with short shafts or a parallel surface pass.
start: Run one farm at a time; the field is reset before every batch.

title: Coal
purpose: Use a persistent group of row workers to mine the first sixteen layers.
start: Start this file from any field; each world is cleared. Coal can be scarce on tiny fields.

title: Iron
purpose: Scout for iron, follow nearby ore and optionally spend coal on prospecting.
start: Coal is replenished through the Coal farm when prospecting is available.

title: Quartz
purpose: Locate quartz from four distance readings and mine the deduplicated targets.
start: Keep iron in stock or allow the ore dependency chain to replenish it.

title: Rice
purpose: Expose clay in one phase, then grow and harvest rice after all digging stops.
start: The field is reset at startup and after the useful clay is exhausted.

title: Bamboo
purpose: Grow dense bamboo beside access lanes and retain the bases after harvest.
start: Keep rice available for the first planting; every worker finishes a bounded batch.

title: Mushrooms
purpose: Match nearby mushroom pairs horizontally and vertically within small tiles.
start: Keep blocks for filling gaps. Pairs across tile boundaries are not combined. Requires at least two cells per side.

title: Dynamite
purpose: Use safe clue deductions and cash out a layer when no further safe move is known.
start: The solver can leave a puzzle incomplete; it does not guess an unknown cell.

title: Pyramids
purpose: Find a limestone foundation, restore sand layers and harvest the reward.
start: Requires a field at least 5 by 5 and enough blocks for placing sand.

title: Fossilized pumpkins
purpose: Expose the local fossil cluster, then mine it in separate color phases.
start: Resets between clusters; search is local to a 9 by 9 window after discovery.

title: Treasure maps
purpose: Read an underground map and follow every direction and dig instruction.
start: The first D already digs the map. Resets after each treasure.

title: Layer mining
purpose: Remove successive depth levels with barriers between color phases.
start: Use a positive layer count for a finite run; ordinary cave-in losses are possible.
